snippet.title: Milki Delivery Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: From the creators of Minami Lane, explore a charming countryside as a young bike courier in Milki Delivery. "Lush meadows, green forests, a glittering ocean... To see it all and reach everyone, you'll need to upgrade your bike, manage your inventory and choose your path wisely." https://store.steampowered.com/app/4259360/Milki_Delivery/ #indiegames #cozygames #gaming
